note: Tested clean-room scene-graph, keyframe, skinning, limited USDA, native-persistence, and Qt desktop subsets. FUNCTIONAL does not mean complete Maya parity; production dependency-graph, rendering, dynamics, scripting, and broad interoperability remain absent.

capabilities.name: Parametric cubic Bezier animation curves with tangents
capabilities.reference_behavior: Evaluate animation channels using cubic Hermite/Bezier curves with custom in/out tangents and clamping.
capabilities.expected_input: Keyframe time, value, and tangent vectors
capabilities.expected_output: Interpolated scalar value at time t

capabilities.name: Hierarchical scene graph and transform evaluation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Hierarchical transform concatenation evaluating local to world matrix transformations.
capabilities.expected_input: Parent-child node tree with TRS transforms
capabilities.differences: Tree hierarchy world-matrix concatenation, cycle-safe reparenting, recursive deletion, and native round-trip are tested. Instancing and a general dependency graph are not implemented.

capabilities.name: Linear Blend Skinning (LBS) skeleton deformation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Deform mesh vertices across animated skeleton joints using 4-bone normalized vertex weights.
capabilities.expected_input: Joint inverse bind matrices and per-vertex skin weights
capabilities.expected_output: Deformed 3D vertex positions at evaluation frame t

capabilities.name: Universal Scene Description (USD USDA) interchange
capabilities.reference_behavior: Export transform nodes, polygonal meshes, and camera definitions to ASCII USDA.
capabilities.differences: A limited USDA text subset is verified for headers and triangle mesh arrays. Full hierarchy, materials, animation samples, skeletons, references, variants, and composition are not exported.

capabilities.name: Interactive playback timeline and frame rate management
capabilities.reference_behavior: Maintain project start/end frames, frame-to-time conversion, and standard production FPS.
capabilities.expected_output: Exact frame / second conversion matching project FPS
capabilities.differences: Frame conversion plus Qt scrubbing, playback stepping, key authoring, and dope-sheet listing are implemented. Audio, ranges/bookmarks, nonlinear animation, curve tangent editing, and cache playback are absent.

capabilities.name: Editable native scene persistence and undo/redo
capabilities.reference_behavior: Save, reopen, and transactionally edit the supported scene hierarchy, meshes, animation, rig, cameras, lights, and timeline.
capabilities.expected_output: Validated lossless round-trip of the supported schema and restorable edit snapshots
capabilities.performance: Whole-scene JSON snapshots; bounded to 100 undo states
capabilities.differences: Supported schema data round-trips and malformed graph references are rejected. Unknown extension preservation, references, namespaces, external caches, incremental saves, crash recovery, and production-scale scene storage are absent.

capabilities.name: Persistent scene, Channel Box, viewport, and timeline workspace
capabilities.reference_behavior: Provide an interactive standalone scene editor with hierarchy, editable channels, evaluated 3D viewport, time controls, key authoring, persistence, export, and undo/redo.
capabilities.expected_input: Create a mesh, edit translation, scrub to a frame, set a channel key, and undo
capabilities.expected_output: Outliner, viewport, Channel Box, and key list remain synchronized with the evaluated document
capabilities.performance: Immediate CPU redraw for tested primitive scenes
capabilities.differences: The tested workspace covers scene creation, numerical channels, key creation, scrubbing/playback, selection, and undo. It lacks transform gizmos, component modeling, GPU drawing, graph-editor tangent manipulation, rigging UI, materials, rendering, dynamics, scripting, and plug-ins.
